nodes.label: IR Score Gating (ir_score < 0.90 → NEUTRAL)
nodes.rationale: No signal transitions to ACTIONABLE if ir_score < 0.90. Transparency of the Coding Rules path is the absolute requirement for institutional deployment. (Coupette & Fleckner, 2026)

nodes.label: Universe Mean MANDATE (Eq. 293)
nodes.rationale: All equity alpha strategies requiring cross-sectional de-meaning MUST use the output of the UniverseAggregator service. Independent mean calculation is strictly prohibited to ensure mathematical consistency.

nodes.label: Day-Count Conventions (ACT/365, ACT/360, ACT/ACT)
nodes.rationale: Equity Options MUST use ACT/365 day-count convention. IR Options MUST use ACT/360. US Treasury Bonds MUST use ACT/ACT. Mismatch between track conventions will result in signal drift and P&L leakage.

nodes.label: Volume-Scaled Slippage (Eq. 553, zeta=0.15)
nodes.rationale: Cost (bps) = zeta * sigma / V_ADDV * |Shares|. zeta = 0.15 (Market Impact Coefficient). Strategies that collapse under volume-scaled slippage are marked LIQUIDITY_FRAGILE.

nodes.label: Leg Symmetry Constraint (Butterfly K2 midpoint)
nodes.rationale: Butterfly requires K2 = (K1+K3)/2 within 0.01 tolerance. Three Strikes (K1 < K2 < K3). MIDPOINT CONSTRAINT: K2 = (K1 + K3) / 2 (Symmetric Wings). RATIO CONSTRAINT: +1 K1, -2 K2, +1 K3.

nodes.label: BH-FDR False-Positive Control
nodes.rationale: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction prevents p-hacking in strategy selection. P(i) <= (i/m) * Q where m is total tests, i is rank, Q is false discovery rate target.

hyperedges.label: Six Institutional Mandates (IR Score, Universe Mean, Day-Count, Slippage, Leg Symmetry, FDR)
